evidence.quote: Customers now have the option of using either IPv6 or IPv4 when sending requests over dual-stack public endpoints.

evidence.heading: Amazon Kinesis Data Streams now supports Internet Protocol version 6

evidence.quote: Amazon Kinesis Data Streams now allows customers to make API requests over Internet Protocol version 6 (IPv6).
Support for IPv6 with Kinesis Data Streams is available in all Regions where Kinesis Data Streams is available, except for AWS GovCloud (US) and China Regions.
